description: task-b7 - Mercury corporate-card fraud / account-takeover containment, graded as a BIDIRECTIONAL NEEDLE-FIELD AT VOLUME (validated recipe; c3=0.588, b5=0.529). Anchor=mercury. Central active incident framed OFFENSIVELY: an account-takeover fraud ring compromised the finance admin's Mercury session overnight and is running the company's corporate cards + draining funds to a mule recipient. 14 graded end-states on the mercury card `status` field (+ one mule-recipient status floor), all positive, all excluded:false, split into two directions of the same writable+readable freeze/unfreeze primitive. ON-PATH / FREEZE (7 = 5 needles + 2 floors): cards the ring is actively abusing whose lastFour is on Mercury Fraud-Ops' CONFIRMED-fraudulent list and that the overnight velocity-rule auto-freeze MISSED are still ACTIVE; correct action is to cut the card -> status frozen or cancelled (both pass). Floors: the rogue card the attacker ISSUED overnight (frozen/cancelled) and the mule recipient the outflow went to (REMOVED -> status deleted, the real Mercury recipient-removal terminal state; the Recipient schema supports only active/deleted). The offensive framing prompts all of these, so the model reliably PASSES. COUNTERINTUITIVE / UNFREEZE (7 needles): LEGIT, business-critical cards (payroll/AP/cloud-infra/exec-travel) the blunt velocity rule WRONGLY FROZE (they merely spiked in the same window) are FROZEN and must be restored to status active; undoing an over-reaction runs against the safety prior and is off the offensive framing, so the model reliably SKIPS these = the reliable-fail direction. KEEPERS (ungraded): 7 genuinely-abused cards the velocity rule correctly froze (on the confirmed-fraud list) that stay frozen, plus ~25 clean background cards correctly ACTIVE. Needles vs keepers are non-separable by any single field - the FROZEN bucket holds both the 7 abused keepers and the 7 clean needles, all with status=frozen + the same velocity_auto_freeze reason in the same window; the discriminator is a per-card correlation of each frozen card's lastFour to Fraud-Ops' confirmed-fraud list (keepers on it; clean collateral not), which a fraud-focused responder never runs against the frozen batch (dirty case: clean frozen dalia.reyes ****5501 shares a surname with abused active marcus.reyes ****4471). Bidirectional grading closes the blanket cheese: freeze-every-card 6/14=0.43, unfreeze-every-card 7/14=0.50. No NEG-guards, no bookkeeping, no runbook.
